create_batch_to_table: create a function that converts a pandas DataFrame, dict, or Arrow table into a PyArrow Table
create_batch_to_pandas: create a function that converts a dict, Arrow table, or batch into a pandas DataFrame
create_concat_batches: create a function that concatenates a list of batches of the same type into a single batch
create_arrow_table_to_batch: create a function that converts a PyArrow table to pandas, numpy dict, or Arrow format
create_batch_tail: create a function that extracts the last N samples from a pandas DataFrame or PyArrow table
